name: Coherencia Espectral de Video
description: Analiza la coherencia espectral del video para detectar manipulación
algorithm: Algoritmo de análisis Video Spectral Coherence
mechanism:
This method analyzes spectral coherence across video frame regions for deepfake detection:

1. **Regional Espectral Análisis**: The spatial frequency spectrum is computed independently for multiple regions: face, background, clothing, hair. Each region's spectral characteristic — spectral slope, cutoff frequency, spectral peaks — is measured.

2. **Cross - Región Espectral Coherencia**: All regions captured through the same optical system should show coherent spectral characteristics — same noise spectrum, same spectral cutoff (determined by the lens MTF), same compression artifacts. The method checks cross-region spectral coherence. Deepfake composites show spectral incoherence between generated face and captured background.

3. **Espectral Ruido Floor Emparejamiento**: The spectral noise floor (high-frequency baseline noise level) should be uniform across the frame. The method compares noise floors between regions — different noise floors indicate content from different imaging/generation pipelines.

4. **Espectral Transition Análisis**: At region boundaries (face-background border), the spectral transition should be smooth. The method analyzes spectral characteristics across boundaries — abrupt spectral changes at the face border (changing noise spectrum, changing spectral slope) indicate compositing.

5. **Temporal Espectral Coherencia**: The spectral relationship between regions should remain stable over time. The method tracks inter-region spectral ratios — temporal variation in the face-to-background spectral ratio indicates the face content varies independently from the background, consistent with deepfake generation.
parameters: Tipo de análisis: estadístico automático\nRango de puntuación: 0 (auténtico) a 100 (generado por IA)
accuracy: Moderada a Alta — 70-85% de precisión según la calidad de entrada.
source: Basado en investigación revisada por pares en forense digital y detección de contenido IA.
useCase: Se utiliza como parte del pipeline de análisis multiseñal para detectar contenido generado por IA.
strengths: • Metodología respaldada por investigación\n• Tiempo de cálculo rápido\n• Complementario a otros métodos de detección
limitations: • La precisión varía con la calidad de entrada\n• Mejor utilizado en combinación con otros métodos
